text: In 2021, the property experienced tree-cover loss of 81.3 hectares, which is 2.23% of the total asset area. This loss was observed in both the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2021-v1.9 and GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which showed that 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020. The forest type over the event area was primarily planted forest. Additionally, there were small patches of loss under 0.5 hectares each, totaling 37.3 hectares, which were not counted as part of the main event.
